text: {"lessons":["My account has declined from its early peak, so I should periodically check whether my holdings and overall risk still fit my goals rather than assume that holding is always best.","I should make any changes based on each stock’s fundamentals, diversification, and my investment plan—not on a short run of losses or a desire to recover quickly.","Because I check infrequently, I should set a simple review schedule and clear criteria for buying, selling, or holding before the next period."]}
